name: myla-language-support
description: Syntax highlighting, snippets and the Myla language server (diagnostics, outline, definition, references, hover, completion).

myla.serverPath.description: Path to the Myla language server binary. Leave empty to use `build/myla-lsp` in the repository (built by `scripts/bootstrap.sh`). `${workspaceFolder}`, `${userHome}` and `~` are expanded.

myla.compilerPath.description: Path to the Myla repository root (the folder containing `myla.py`), where the language server is `build/myla-lsp`. Leave empty to auto-detect from the workspace folders. `${workspaceFolder}`, `${userHome}` and `~` are expanded.

myla.diagnostics.enable.description: Show the Myla compiler's diagnostics. When off, the language server keeps running for hover, definition and the rest.

myla.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the Myla language server.
